create_extractor: create a ViT extractor module that registers forward hooks to capture intermediate layer latents
run_extractor_forward: run the extractor forward pass on an image tensor to get predictions and extracted embeddings
eject_extractor: eject the extractor to remove registered hooks and return the original ViT model
build_extractor_layer: build an extractor targeting a specific layer or layer name to capture intermediate representations
review_extractor_detach: review the extractor's detach behavior for cloning and detaching captured latent tensors
